{{Top|leg}}
The '''universal transliterator''' was a device capable of translating [[Gamorrese]] into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]]. The Gamorrean [[Thok (Gamorrean guard)/Legends|Thok]] acquired a universal [[transliterator]] on his homeworld of [[Pzob/Legends|Pzob]], which allowed him and his brother [[Gorc]] to excape offworld.
